parameters.name: BytesSent
parameters.description: The total number of {{units}} handled in the outbound direction by the IKEv2 SA.

parameters.name: BytesReceived
parameters.description: The total number of {{units}} handled in the inbound direction by the IKEv2 SA.

parameters.name: PacketsSent
parameters.description: The total number of {{units}} handled in the outbound direction by the IKEv2 SA.

parameters.name: PacketsReceived
parameters.description: The total number of {{units}} handled in the inbound direction by the IKEv2 SA.

parameters.name: ErrorsSent
parameters.description: The total number of outbound {{units}} from this IKEv2 SA discarded for any reason. This can include {{units}} dropped due to a lack of transmit buffer space. Note that this refers to IKE protocol {{units}}, and not to {{units}} carried by other SAs.

parameters.name: DecryptionErrors
parameters.description: The total number of inbound {{units}} to this IKEv2 SA discarded due to decryption errors. Note that this refers to IKEv2 protocol {{units}}, and not to {units}} carried by other SAs.

parameters.name: IntegrityErrors
parameters.description: The total number of inbound {{units}} to this IKEv2 SA discarded due to integrity errors. Note that this refers to IKEv2 protocol {{units}}, and not to {{units}} carried by other SAs.

parameters.name: OtherReceiveErrors
parameters.description: The total number of inbound {{units}} to this IKEv2 SA discarded for reasons other than decryption or integrity errors. This can include {{units}} dropped due to a lack of receive buffer space. Note that this refers to IKEv2 protocol {{units}}, and not to {{units}} carried by other SAs.

object.description: Statistics for this IKEv2 Security Association (SA). The CPE MUST reset the IKEv2 SA's Stats parameters (unless otherwise stated in individual object or parameter descriptions) whenever the associated {{param|#.Tunnel}} instance's Stats parameters are reset.
